operational-example.copy: Use Station Pin to represent one actionable map marker value without turning map behavior into a component.

scenario.title: Nearby station prices
rationale: Station Pin keeps the map marker value compact and legible over map surfaces.
The accessible name carries station identity, price or value, and short status.
Use patterns when pins require clustering rules, filters, route drawing, or station detail sheets.

items.rule: Carries the icon or cluster count inside the pin.
Shows the short price, count, or station value visible on the map.
Anchors the pin to a map coordinate without owning map positioning.
Uses button semantics only when the pin opens detail or route action.

accessibility.statePrecedence: disabled, unavailable, selected, focus, hover, default
items: Use a button only when the pin opens detail or route action.
Expose station name, visible value, and status in the accessible name.
Do not rely on the marker icon as the only meaning.
Keep focus ring outside the pill marker shape.
Represent unavailable stations with text in the accessible name and disabled behavior.

variants.copy: Station Pin variants represent station type or cluster behavior while preserving a single marker contract.

states.copy: Station Pin states communicate availability, selection, hover, focus, and disabled behavior on map surfaces.

variant-state-behavior.copy: Variant identifies the station type; state tells whether the pin is available, selected, or blocked.

full-width.copy: Station Pin should not stretch its marker; full-width demos preserve map context while the pin target stays stable.

responsive-layout-patterns.copy: Keep pins large enough to tap on phones and avoid dense marker groups before a map pattern owns clustering.

viewport-organization.copy: Station Pin stays a marker component; viewport rules decide touch target, label visibility, and cluster escalation.

items.title: Phone
items.rule: Keep the tap target generous while the visible value stays compact.

items.title: Tablet
items.rule: Show the selected value with stronger depth when route context is visible.

items.title: Desktop
items.rule: Escalate dense groups to map patterns that own filtering and zoom.

playground.copy: Use the playground to verify marker type, state, accessible label, and whether the pin should be interactive.
playground.snippet: <StationPin label="Pemex Polanco" value="$23.4" meta="1.8 km - 24 h" />

api-foundations.copy: Station Pin API exposes station identity, visible marker value, type, state, count, and action while the Design System owns marker shape, contrast, focus, depth, and motion.

props.name: value
props.notes: Short visible marker value, such as price or rate.

props.name: meta
props.notes: Short status included in the accessible name.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Station type or cluster marker treatment.

props.name: density
props.notes: Flow density inherited from viewport or context.

props.name: selected
props.notes: Convenience flag that maps to selected state.

props.name: unavailable
props.notes: Convenience flag that maps to unavailable state.

groups.title: Use
items: Use value for compact visible price, rate, or count.
Use selected for the active location.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not use pins as generic badges.
Do not hide unavailable status from the accessible name.
Do not implement clustering, filtering, or route drawing inside the component.

mustTest: Accessible name includes station identity and value
rejectIf: The component owns map clustering logic.
The target is too small for mobile.

miel.copy: MIEL treats Station Pin as one compact map marker. Agents can choose it for a known location, but humans confirm value source, status meaning, action, and whether a map pattern should own clustering.
canDecide: Use Station Pin for one fuel, EV, service, or cluster marker.
Use selected for the active route or station detail.
Use unavailable only when the pin cannot be chosen.
mustAsk: Pin selection changes route or spending decisions.
Many pins need filtering, zoom, or clustering.
Station value or status source is unclear.
rejectIf: The pin has no visible value.
The pin owns map layout rules.
miel.handoff: I am using Station Pin for one actionable location. Please confirm value source, status source, accessible label, and whether clustering belongs in a map pattern.
